intro: Recovered from the Burning Blade cultist Gazz'uz in the depths of Skull Rock, this mysterious glowing pendant whispers urgent warnings into the bearer's mind. The voice specifically threatens Gazz'uz with the wrath of Neeru Fireblade, an orc warlock residing in Orgrimmar.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There is word of your discovery in Skull Rock. You must prepare for an attack!
Gazz'uz, I order you to speak! Speak or I will make sure Neeru Fireblade knows of your presence, and he will descend on you with swift brutality.
Do not test your skills against Neeru...

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have something vital to report. I can sense it behind your eyes.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Intriguing. The voice you heard mentioned my name? I am known for hunting down enemies of our Warchief, but...it is strange that I was singled out. Stranger still that the Burning Blade cultists from whom you recovered this pendant have a name so close to my own.
I must study this pendant. I must study and, and must ponder the meaning of its message.
Thank you for bringing this to my attention, friend. You have done your people a great service.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
